First boot test of the TF dimension (any later worldgen feature that boot-tests it, e.g. landmark-density-terrain or lich-tower-revamp): TFBeardifier.WARP_NOISE_TO_DENSITY = 1/78 is exact only for scale-0.05 biomes. The warp slope per block is 2/32 * 2.5 * 96 / (0.9*scale + 0.1) / 8, so after scaling it is about 0.23 per block in Dark Forest and Dark Forest Center (scale 0.005: Dark Tower, Knight Stronghold), about 0.20 on the Final Plateau (0.025) and about 0.074 in the Highlands (0.25: Troll Cave), against 4.8's uniform 1/6. The x4 of positive noise is applied before the noise is added in computeInitialDensity, but toBeardDensity divides the whole interpolated value, so the beard strength can be off by up to about 4x for one or two blocks near the surface. Generate fresh chunks and look at a Lich Tower and Dark Tower entrance (BEARD_BOX floor fill), a Hedge Maze edge and a Knight Stronghold entrance mound. If the Dark Forest or Highlands beards look off, derive the factor per column from the TerrainColumn scale instead of using a constant. PARTLY DONE in landmark-density-terrain (fbacdad): its terraformers are scaled by 8 or 16 or only add density, so they do not depend on the warp scale; the Dark Tower entrance and Knight Stronghold ruins of a fresh world sat on level ground. Not yet looked at: a Highlands Troll Cave, a Lich Tower and a Hedge Maze edge beard (lich-tower-revamp boot test).
